shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, long shot, low-angle composition: an elderly woman wearing a glowing spacesuit stands before the space station’s outer hull, positioned in the lower third of the frame. Behind her, the curved module and distant starfield form leading lines. Slight floating particles in the foreground enhance spatial depth. Cold blue edge lighting outlines the helmet and shoulder armor. After standing still, she slightly turns her head; The camera slowly pushes in.
shot2: Shot 2 cuts hard from the previous shot, medium-close up, eye-level: the camera closely frames the front of the helmet. Clear, sharp high-density credits scroll vertically downward from the top of the frame, sweeping across the curved surface of the helmet before continuing upward. Columnar text appears stable with no corruption. Left column displays "主演", "摄影"; right column shows "美术指导", "声音设计". Text appears in semi-transparent cool white holographic material with thin cyan outer glow. Reflection on the helmet’s curved surface causes slight perspective distortion but edges remain sharp. She takes one step forward;
shot3: Shot 3 enters via a quick wipe cut from the previous shot, wide shot, eye-level: scene shifts to the connection area before the airlock. The corridor’s depth lines draw the viewer forward. She reaches out and presses the illuminated panel beside the door, pushing open the heavy airlock. As the door opens, cold white vapor and blue indicator lights escape. Credits now roll continuously upward along the right vertical edge of the frame, leaving full space on the left for action. Door hinge motion, arm exertion, and fabric creasing on the suit sleeve are clearly visible. The airlock opening The camera transitions from slight pull-back to smooth follow-in.
shot4: Shot 4 cuts hard from the previous shot, close-up, side eye-level: after entering the corridor, she pauses half a second. Her side profile is framed alongside swirling nebula outside the viewport. Foreground features softly defocused module framing; background shows purple-blue nebula and sparse ship lights. Fine credit text reflects along the edge of the transparent visor. A black zone on the left allows columnar flashes of text, displaying "剪辑" and "视觉设计" as narrow vertical lines that flash orderly and merge into the upward scroll—like electronic end cards. She briefly gazes outward; facial wrinkles appear soft and clear under cold reflection. The camera moves extremely slowly forward.
shot5: Shot 5 fades into the previous shot, extreme close-up, slightly tilted overhead angle: focus rests on her gloved hand gliding over a glowing railing. The railing shifts from dark blue to cyan-white, leaving brief flowing light trails on its metallic surface. In shallow foreground depth, tiny scrolling text flows past. Background shows blurred corridor light strips. This shot emphasizes texture detail. Credits use extremely small font arranged diagonally from bottom-left to top-right as auxiliary layout, where "服装", "道具", "特别鸣谢" are legible, rendered with laser-etched sharpness. Her hand movement causes slight bending at glove joints. The camera pans smoothly along the railing direction.
shot6: Shot 6 connects via an electronic scan transition from the previous shot, medium shot, eye-level: she walks through a corridor composed of transparent data screens. Floating interfaces appear in both foreground and background but do not block her face. End credits on the screens scroll vertically and occasionally flash in columns. Text density increases yet remains stable and clear. Corridor light strips and credits together create strong perspective. She walks calmly; her glowing suit reflects cold tones off the screens. A brief refraction effect occurs when the screen edge sweeps past her shoulder. The camera slightly pulls back while following to keep her centered.
shot7: Shot 7 cuts hard from the previous shot, medium-long shot, slightly low-angle from behind: she reaches the end of the corridor and looks back at the distant fleet. Outside the viewport, multiple ships’ light strips move slowly. Composition uses her back and shoulders as foreground, fleet as background. Credits retreat to vertical columns on both sides of the frame, continuing upward like real end credits. Right column displays "联合出品", "后期总监". She stops and turns; edge lighting on her helmet traces fine light streaks during motion. The camera shifts from static to a slight half-circle orbit, emphasizing the look-back gesture.
shot8: Shot 8 transitions with a fade-in/fade-out from the previous shot, medium shot, eye-level: scene naturally continues to the entrance of the observation cabin. She slowly turns and sits in a window-side seat. Curved lines of the seat and cabin wall draw attention to her. Cold white ceiling lights and blue-purple starlight outside overlap on her suit. Credits now concentrate in the center-right of the frame, scrolling rapidly in two columns—like the dense segment just before the climax of real end credits. Her sitting motion includes clear shoulder drop, knee bend, and hand gripping the seat edge. Seat cushion rebound is subtly visible. The camera slowly tilts down and slightly pushes in.
shot9: Shot 9 cuts hard from the previous shot, extreme wide shot, slightly tilted overhead angle: viewed from above the observation cabin, she sits alone before a curved viewport. Massive credits surge upward from the bottom of the frame, occupying the central axis and split into three columns, including "制片", "调色", "混音", "视觉效果", "发行". Text features cool white metallic outline with faint blue glow, neatly aligned and stable, with no jumping or corruption. She remains a quiet silhouette behind the dense text, creating an advertising-style end credit impact. Background The camera slowly rises then gently pulls back, enhancing both subtitle speed and spatial depth.
shot10: Shot 10 cuts quickly with a zoom from the previous shot, extreme close-up, eye-level, the lens moving directly to her eyes, where both her pupils and the inner layer of her visor reflect scrolling credits, "执行制片", "原创音乐", etc., mirrored in her eyes with sharp-edged text resembling etching on glass; fine wrinkles around her eyes and subtle moisture enhance the character's lifelikeness; her gaze slowly follows the upward-scrolling text, blinking once almost imperceptibly; the camera performs an extremely slow push-in, drawing the emotional tone of the ending to its most intimate moment.
shot11: Shot 11 fades in from the previous shot, medium long shot, eye-level; after standing up, she walks alone toward the end of the corridor; light strips along both sides converge toward the endpoint, forming strong leading lines; the credits reappear as full columns on the left and right, continuing to scroll upward, leaving a central depth channel for the character; "特别鸣谢" briefly flashes in the bottom right corner before merging into the scrolling list; her steps are slower than before, the glowing lines on her spacesuit extending in sync with reflections on the floor during movement, amplifying the sense of solitude; the camera follows at a slow pace and gradually stops, allowing her to walk away into the depths of the frame.
shot12: Shot 12 ends with an extremely slow fade-in to the final scene, long shot, eye-level slightly upward tilt; she stops in front of the viewport window, the frame freezing on her silhouette against the vast starfield; the final credits "终幕呈现" and "感谢观看" appear in bright, cold white font centered at the bottom of the screen, with a material texture resembling polished titanium coated with a thin holographic film; all text remains stable, clear, and free of glitches; outside, the starfield gently flows, distant ship lights flicker far away, mechanical hums and broadcast static gradually fade out, leaving only an open, calm conclusion; the camera remains completely still, ending the film with a commercial-style lingering aftertaste.
